T: Stick it to the man. Then eat.
D: A broke rock musician poses as a substitute teacher and turns his class into a band.
P: Serve the snacks when the class gets their band parts.
S: Dewey keeps eating Ned's labelled food
Mini sandwiches of ham, cheese and pickle and egg and lettuce, each wrapped in baking paper with a name written on it in marker.
Battle of the Bands honey corn dogs
the big show at the end

Franks on sticks dipped in a sweet honey cornmeal and buttermilk batter, fried deep golden, with yellow mustard and tomato sauce for squirting. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk into a thick batter and pour into a tall glass. Pat 8 franks dry, push a skewer into each and dust with flour. Heat 1.5L oil to 180C. Dip each frank in the batter and fry for 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.
Cheddar, butter and flour pastry rolled thin, cut into stars, brushed with egg, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.
M: Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, mozzarella, pepperoni and chilli honey, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
Roadhouse bacon and onion ring burgers
Dewey takes the principal out for a beer

Thick chuck patties grilled medium with cheddar and crisp bacon, topped with beer-battered onion rings and smoky barbecue mayo on toasted buns. Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 thick patties. Whisk 100g flour with 150ml cold soda water, dip thick rings from a large onion and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp. Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Grill the patties 4 minutes a side, adding cheddar for the last minute. Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 2 tbsp barbecue sauce. Stack on toasted buns with bacon, onion rings and sauce.
W: Butter sugar cookies cut into guitars, baked at 180C for 8 minutes, iced with red, black and white royal icing.
K: Raspberries, orange and pineapple juice stirred with fresh lime and topped with lemonade, ice, sliced oranges and mint in a big jug. Lightly crush 125g raspberries in a big jug with the juice of 2 limes. Add 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and stir. Just before serving fill with ice, top with 750ml cold lemonade and add sliced oranges and a few mint sprigs. Pour so everyone gets some berries.

s.note: Dewey keeps eating Ned's labelled food
s.how: Boil 3 eggs, mash with mayo. Make ham, cheese and pickle sandwiches, and egg and lettuce sandwiches, using 12 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar. Cut small, wrap each in baking paper and write a name on it in marker.

Rub 80g butter into 150g flour, then add 120g grated vintage cheddar and a pinch of paprika. Bring together with a splash of water. Roll thin, cut into stars, brush with egg and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

m.how: Stretch 500g dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Warm 3 tbsp honey with chilli flakes and drizzle over.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll out, cut into guitar shapes and bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Mix 300g icing sugar with egg white and a little water, colour some red and black, and decorate.

d.how: Lightly crush 125g raspberries in a big jug with the juice of 2 limes. Add 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice and stir. Just before serving fill with ice, top with 750ml cold lemonade and add sliced oranges and a few mint sprigs. Pour so everyone gets some berries.
